## New
- Downloads tab: turn it on in Settings › Appearance › Navigation bar
- Download with Flow in the share menu opens the download menu for a shared video
- Swipe a download away to delete it, with Undo (#1415)
- Ask before deleting setting: turn it off to delete from the menu without a dialog (#1415)
- Storage summary setting hides the space used and free in Downloads

## Improved
- Deleting downloads now shows Undo (#1415)
